issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
covered_actors: those designing, developing, deploying, or using AI systems

evidence.quote: ISO/IEC FDIS23894 Information technology - Artificial intelligence - Guidance on risk management
help manage the many risks of AI and promote trustworthy and responsible development and use of AI systems
NIST leads and participates in the development of technical standards...that promote innovation and public trust in systems that use AI
NIST seeks out AI standards development opportunities, periodically collecting and analyzing information about agencies' AI standards-related priority activities and making recommendations

enforcement_authorities: ICSP AI Standards Coordination Working Group (AISCWG)
implementation_notes: NIST acts as federal AI standards coordinator, facilitating interagency coordination and international engagement. Key outputs include AI RMF, AI 100-5e2025 global engagement plan, AI Standards Zero Drafts project, and crosswalks to ISO/IEC and OECD standards. Standards developed are voluntary consensus standards. A report on evaluating AI standards development was released January 15, 2026.
